node.statement: Unpacking the parent node 1.1 phrase ambient finite-dimensional raw-factor setup for this branch: fix an integer d>=1, H=C^d, a UCP map Phi:B(H)->B(H), and eta>=0 with ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb<=eta; define tilde-Phi by the functional-calculus formula in lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization and set A=Im(tilde-Phi). These are standing hypotheses of the raw-factor branch, not consequences of finite-dimensionality.
